high_level_description: The image features a quote attributed to Seneca, a Roman philosopher and statesman. The quote reads: "We suffer more often in imagination than in reality." This text is presented on the left side of the image in a clean, black font against a white background. On the right side of the image, there is a portrait of an older man with long, curly hair and a beard. The portrait appears to be a classical painting or a highly detailed illustration, giving it a historical and scholarly feel. The man's expression is serious, and he looks directly at the viewer, adding a sense of gravitas to the image.
